alt: Poster: Nifty 50 23,810.85 (+1.58%), Sensex 76,917.85 (+1.62%), Nifty Smallcap 100 +0.3% on 3 Nov 2026
text:
Indian benchmarks rose for a fourth straight session on Tuesday, with Sensex gaining over 1,200 points.

• Sensex closed at 76,917.85, up 1,225.07 points (1.62%); Nifty 50 closed at 23,810.85, up 370.05 points (1.58%), per HDFC Sky and Kotak Neo closing reports.
• Nifty 50 rose for a fourth consecutive session, per Kotak Neo and 5paisa.
• Broader markets lagged the benchmarks: Nifty Smallcap 100 gained about 0.3%, per 5paisa and HDFC Sky.
• Brent crude traded above $100 a barrel, per Kotak Neo and Business Standard; Kotak Neo flags elevated crude and geopolitical uncertainty as risks to the rally.

Our view: a multi-day advance led by large caps can look strong at the index level while the average stock participates less, as the smallcap gap suggests. Elevated crude and geopolitical news are variables that could change sentiment quickly, though one session says little about direction. This is an interpretation, not a prediction or advice.

For practitioners: after a four-session run, what do you look at to judge how broad a rally really is, beyond the headline index?
